title: State v. Marsh
facts: Neighbors reported a loud altercation at the defendant's residence
The complainant later recanted parts of her initial statement to police
jury_instructions: Recantation does not automatically negate a prior consistent statement; weigh all statements and their circumstances.

evidence_items.content: Responding officer testified the complainant had visible injuries and stated the defendant struck her.
At trial, the complainant testified she fell and the defendant did not hit her.
911 call recording in which the complainant is heard naming the defendant as the attacker.
